items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: What's that name? Emile or something? Yeah. Millie Bond.

ctx.x: George Lewis? Oh, he was good when he was with me and Kid Allen.

Yeah. And we used to play with some band before me and George. Oh, with Oral Lumpus band. We played. Then we left Oral Lumpus band. We played. Then we left Oral Lumpus band. We played. Then we left Oral Lumpus band. We was good then. And we tried to get him to go on site. He tried once, but he didn't like it until he got back on Clionette. Then Clionette come back, but she didn't have nothing to do with that. What's that name? Emile or something? Yeah. Millie Bond. Millie Bond. Millie Bond.
